title: IMPACTS SOUND LIKE WHAT THEY HIT
why: His number 45, improve all sound as much as possible. Every round that hit a wall made the same faint tick, a tree the same as a car door or a window, and every round that hit a body made the same blip, a pillager the same as a Warden. Now what you hit is heard: concrete chips, wood thocks, glass shatters, metal and armour ring, flesh thuds. The other window in co-op hears the same material. The menu clank that says no is unchanged, and nothing about where rounds go or what the map rolls moves.
now: Bullet impacts sound like what they hit: concrete, wood, glass, metal, armour or flesh.
